title: Attention connects text pieces
summary: Attention is a calculation that lets one token use information from other tokens in its allowed context. Transformers use attention alongside other layers.
introduction: Attention is a calculation that lets one token use information from other tokens in its allowed context. Transformers use attention alongside other layers. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Attention weights alone are not a complete explanation of why a model answered a certain way.
